text:
nora: kicking off onboarding for Specter LoRA merge in sandbox. quick heads-up: two signals — embedding recall down on cust_faqs and a small uptick in generation perplexity after our OPTQ int4 pass. opening thread to triage.

ethan: uploaded quick-eval artifacts https://internal.redwood/quick-evals/4991234567 — summary: embed_recall 0.89 -> 0.76, mean cosine delta -0.14, generation_ppl 11.8 -> 12.9 :frowning_face:  

sam: any chance the adapter used a different preproc/tokenizer? I saw a weird "paren-glue" phenomenon where parentheses get token-glued in the adapter training data and that can change token alignment post-quant. small repro below.

```
orig: "See pricing (incl. tax)"
tokens(base): [102, 450, 77, 9001]
tokens(specter-adapter): [102, 450, 33210, 77, 9001]  // '(' glued to preceding token in adapter tokenizer
```

zara: important note — the merge pipeline used OPTQ int4 with fold-v2.1; we have a fold-v2.4 available that slightly changes layernorm folding numerics. can amplify kv-cache differences post-quant. worth testing fold-v2.4 + bnb-int8.

eval-bot: [auto] quickpack finished: /artifacts/4991234567/quickpack.json — generation thresholds marginal, embedding_recall FAILED (delta -0.13). reranker_passrate 0.93 -> 0.68.

ethan: repro command for the limited failing set: 

```
./run_quick_eval.sh --model specter-lora-merge:v3 --quant optq-int4 --dataset cust_faqs --seed 99 --limit 60
```

(6m)

ethan: top human diffs from limit=60 run: 
1) Q: "How do I change my billing address?"
   base top1: "Go to Account > Address"
   specter top1: "Update your billing address in settings"  // similar but embedding cosine drops 0.07
2) Q: "What's your return period?"
   base: "45 days from delivery"
   specter: "Returns accepted within 45 days"  // phrasing shift, reranker falls below cutoff
3) Q: "Are taxes included in prices?"
   base: "Prices include tax where applicable"
   specter: "Includes tax when applicable"  // rank shifts off top2

sam: downstream systems have tight reranker thresholds; those small vector deltas cascade. potential mitigations: 1) mapper/shim at merge-time to align tokenizer boundaries (paren-glue fixes), 2) re-export adapter with prod tokenizer and re-run, 3) use bnb int8 for customer deploy, 4) short anchor-finetune (100-200 steps) on cust_faq anchors to re-anchor embeddings.

zara: i'll test fold-v2.4 vs fold-v2.1 numerics in the OPTQ job and run a bnb-int8 baseline. also will run a run with the tokenizer mapping applied to the input stream to estimate impact without rebuilding the adapter.

eval-bot: [auto] noted request: quickpack recipe will include reranker_passrate + token-diff histogram for this canary per @nora.

nora: next steps — prototype tokenizer shim to normalize parentheses/decimal/abbrev boundaries and add a small token-diff CI check; run quant matrix (optq-int4 fold-v2.1, optq-int4 fold-v2.4, bnb-int8) on canary after shim. if shim + int8 still fails, trial a 150-step anchor-finetune to measure recall recovery. target: mitigation decision in 36-48h. opening ticket INF-478 and tagging @eng-ml @customer-success. :thumbsup:

ethan: PR for tokenizer shim + CI token-diff script coming shortly (will include minimal failing examples).

sam: once the PR lands, i'll re-run the quickpack matrix and paste final artifacts here. keep notes in the model-onboarding doc. thanks team!
